item_short_desc: Rothco’s Mini Flashlight is a dependable tool for various outdoor tasks. Crafted from high-impact plastic, the camping flashlight is lightweight and waterproof. Equipped with a multi-mode switch and a signal button for Morse code, the flashlight allows you to make survival signals during emergencies. The flashlight includes 4 filter lenses in red, blue, yellow, or green stored conveniently in the bottom section. In addition, the survival tool features a spare bulb tucked under the battery spring for emergency situations.
